_comment: Staging overrides. Real values (RedirectUri, secrets, connection strings, CORS origins) must be supplied via environment variables / Azure App Service configuration for the Staging slot -- nothing here should ever be a copy of Production's values.

BlobStorage._comment: Suffixed container/queue names so Staging shares the same Storage Account as Production without touching its data. These containers/queue must still be created in Azure before Staging can use them -- that is not done by this file.
